title: Rootpath Rehearsal
user: FastAPI developers serving applications beneath a reverse-proxy prefix
problem: An endpoint can work while redirects point at an internal host or the documentation requests an unreachable OpenAPI schema.
capability: Replay public-path probes through a local ASGI proxy model and compare redirect targets, docs schema URLs and OpenAPI server prefixes across configurations.
pin: FastAPI 0.162.0 and HTTPX 0.28.1. The scope model follows Uvicorn full-path construction in https://github.com/Kludex/uvicorn/blob/main/uvicorn/protocols/http/h11_impl.py
query: api framework stars:>10000 archived:false sort:stars; fastapi proxy test sort:stars
demand: The current official proxy guide describes the concrete redirect and stripped-prefix problems. Issue829 is historical and closed; this tool does not claim the framework still has that bug. A reusable multi-scenario rehearsal is an inferred need.
addition: FastAPI documents the configuration, Uvicorn serves ASGI applications and HTTPX provides a transport. This project assembles a repeatable public-URL contract with specific diagnoses. It is a local model, not a replacement for a real proxy deployment test.
outcome: The correct invented /edge scenario passes. Omitting root_path breaks docs/public redirects; rejecting forwarded-origin information exposes an internal-origin redirect.
acceptance: Correct wiring reaches the docs schema and preserves HTTPS /edge redirect targets.
Wrong root path and forwarded-origin scenarios produce specific findings.
A supplied local factory receives requests without external network access.
Scenario app instances do not share an OpenAPI cache.
fields: Supply an HTTP(S) `public_origin` without credentials, a plain `prefix`, a scenarios array and optional local `probes`. Each scenario names root_path, strip_prefix, trust_forwarded and optional upstream_origin. Defaults use the bundled invented FastAPI app. `--factory MODULE:FUNCTION` imports your own local code and creates a fresh ASGI application per scenario.
limits: 4 MiB JSON; 1..20 scenarios and 1..20 probes; each local probe has a five-second deadline. Plain paths only. No sockets, DNS, TLS, actual proxy, WebSockets, authentication, lifespan startup or production access are tested. Factory imports and GET handlers execute your code; use a safe test application and isolated fixtures. Forwarding trust here is a simulation setting, not advice to trust arbitrary headers on a deployed server.
distinction: Existing http-range-witness and cookie-scope-witness explain protocol semantics; api-mocker supplies mocks. This tool executes ASGI URL wiring contracts against a real FastAPI application.
maintenance: Pinned FastAPI and HTTPX dependencies. Recheck ASGI server root_path construction and Starlette redirect behavior on upgrades. No claim of end-to-end TLS or network compatibility.
discovery: A three-scenario HTML comparison showing working versus broken /edge routes, plus a factory example for local applications.
demand_status: Inferred demand for this specific project; linked upstream evidence is qualified below.
